connector.name: Blixtworks
connector.registryDescription: 63 pay-per-call tools for agents: vision, text, data, web, blockchain. USDC on Base via x402.
connector.summary: Hosted at blixtworks.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package blixtworks-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace com.blixtworks.www. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: BLIXTWORKS_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: Private key of a wallet holding a small amount of USDC on Base. Used only to sign per-request payments (well under a cent per call). Use a dedicated low-balance wallet. Without it the free status tool still works.
